project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: A porch may qualify with a footprint up to 3 square metres, height up to 3m and at least 2m from a road-facing boundary.
This allowance does not apply in a conservation area; check other restrictions and approvals.
